Now build the SQL. Join cards c on legalities l via c.uuid = l.uuid. Filter l.format='commander' AND l.status='Legal', and power IS NULL OR power='*'.

Note: careful — a card may have multiple legality rows for commander? Probably one per card-format pair. But join could produce duplicates. Let's use DISTINCT or check.

input.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS distinct_ids,
       SUM(CASE WHEN c.power IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_power,
       SUM(CASE WHEN c.power = '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS star_power
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE l.format = 'commander' AND l.status = 'Legal'
  AND (c.power IS NULL OR c.power = '*')
